_note: Dungeons unlock in order: clear one (beat its floor-10 boss) to open the next. A cleared dungeon can be replayed as The Abyss: floors 1-20, bosses on 10 and 20, better boon odds and mythic items on floors 11-20, and a trophy for beating floor 20. Monsters reuse the same roster at higher levels: monster level = level_offset + 1 + (floor - 1) * level_per_floor.
